Author: IndividualGather
Name: XIV MCP
Punchline: Your mammet assistant: connect Claude and other AI assistants to your game through the Model Context Protocol.
Description:
XIV MCP runs a local MCP server (localhost only, protected by an access token) so AI assistants like Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor can see and help with your game.

Read your character live: stats and jobs, gear, inventory, currencies, quests, achievements and every unlock (mounts, minions, orchestrion, cards, ...), party, targets, nearby objects, FATEs and the full game data sheets.

Retainers and submersibles are remembered between visits: every retainer's inventory and listings, and your FC subs' ranks, builds, routes and return times, each with its age and a hint on how to refresh it.

Optional, each behind its own switch in /xivmcp:
- Game interaction: open windows and use the summoning bell, company chest or voyage control panel.
- Inventory actions: sort with the game's own /itemsort, move items between bags, armory, saddlebag and retainers, and transfer stacks between retainers.
- Plugin management: enable, disable or reload Dalamud plugins and edit their settings (with backups).

Plays nicely with AutoRetainer, YesAlready and TextAdvance: they are paused automatically while XIV MCP uses the summoning bell.
